note: v1, written - the first round. EVERYTHING FALLS TO ONE: the Collatz rule as melody and form. Each phrase starts from a seed and a physical clarinet plays its path (n -> n/2 or 3n+1), one number an eighth at scale degree round(log2 n) on G major, so every climb is a melodic climb and every phrase - of its own irregular length - ends 4 2 1 = B3 A3 G3, the hook. Seeds 6 / 7 12 3 7 / 9 18 11 / 27 31 27 41 (27's 111-step climb to 9232 is the drop) / the loop 1 4 2 1.
